entries.title: I Chronicles 25:1
segments: And David and the army commanders separated to the service those of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who [were] prophets with lyres and with cymbals. And the number of the workmen according to their service was:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:2
segments: of the sons of Asaph, Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:3
segments: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, [and Shimei], six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:4
segments: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Josh-bekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:5
segments: All these [were] the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:6
segments: All these [were] under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:7
segments: So the number of them, with their brothers who [were] instructed in the songs of the LORD, all that [were] skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:8
segments: And they cast lots, for duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher as the pupil.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:9
segments: And the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second was to Gedaliah, with his brothers and sons, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:10
segments: the third [was] to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve men;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:11
segments: the fourth [was] to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:12
segments: the fifth [was] to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

segments: the sixth [was] to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:14
segments: the seventh [was] to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:15
segments: the eighth [was] to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:16
segments: the ninth [was] to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:17
segments: the tenth [was] to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:18
segments: the eleventh [was] to Azareel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:19
segments: the twelfth [was] to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:20

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:21
segments: the fourteenth [was] to Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:22
segments: the fifteenth [was] to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve,

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:23

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:27
